headlines.title: 央行上海总部：扎实落实适度宽松的货币政策 积极推动金融机构深挖有效信贷需求
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行上海总部8月4日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，人民银行上海总部要扎实落实适度宽松的货币政策，积极推动金融机构深挖有效信贷需求。用好各项结构性货币政策工具。贯彻落实金融“五篇大文章”1+N系列政策。推动债券市场“科技板”在上海持续见效。稳步深化金融改革和对外开放，构建完善外汇管理体制机制。落实跨境贸易投融资高水平开放、境外放款、境外上市等各项新政。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: Firmly implement moderately accommodative monetary policy, actively push financial institutions to tap effective credit demand
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Head Office of the People's Bank of China (PBOC) held its second-half 2026 work conference on August 4. The meeting stressed that the Shanghai Head Office should solidly implement a moderately loose monetary policy, actively encourage financial institutions to tap into effective credit demand, and make good use of various structural monetary policy tools. It also called for implementing the 'Five Major Articles' 1+N policy series in finance, promoting the sustained effectiveness of the bond market's 'Technology Board' in Shanghai, steadily deepening financial reforms and opening-up, building and improving the foreign exchange management system, and implementing new policies for high-level opening of cross-border trade and investment financing, overseas lending, and overseas listings.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title_en: China's Ministry of Finance sees record-low yields on multiple-tenor Dim Sum bonds, subscription multiples hit over one-year high
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Finance announced on Wednesday that it issued RMB 15 billion in sovereign bonds in Hong Kong, with record-low issuance rates for 2-year, 15-year, and 30-year tranches. The 3-year and 5-year tranches saw rates at their lowest since 2011. The overall subscription ratio for the five renminbi sovereign bonds was 4.67 times, the highest since June 2025. The 2-year tranche was RMB 5 billion at 1.27%, the 3-year at RMB 4 billion at 1.30%, the 5-year at RMB 4 billion at 1.43%, the 15-year at RMB 1 billion at 1.99%, and the 30-year at RMB 1 billion at 2.24%.

headlines.title_en: Aug 5 midday close: STAR 50 index up over 5% in half-day session, semiconductor chip stocks rally collectively
headlines.summary_en: 1. Markets opened lower and rallied in the morning session, with the STAR 50 Index up over 5%. Semiconductor chip stocks strengthened broadly, with Zhongju Core, Zhengfan Technology, Jinhaitong, Dawei Co., and others hitting limit-up. Precious metals gained, with Sichuan Gold hitting limit-up. PCB concept stocks rose, with Zhongjing Electronics and Huazheng New Materials hitting limit-up. Intelligent driving concepts were active, with Suoling Shares, Zhejiang Shibao, and Xingmin Zhitong hitting limit-up. Rising stocks outnumbered decliners, with over 3,900 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing up, and morning turnover reached RMB 1.7 trillion. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.34%, Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.56%, and ChiNext rose 0.89%. 2. Leading sectors included semiconductor chips, precious metals, computing hardware, and consumer electronics, while oil and gas, banks, baijiu, and traditional Chinese medicine fell against the trend. 3. Across the two exchanges, 3,631 stocks rose with 89 hitting limit-up, while 1,351 fell with 2 hitting limit-down.

headlines.summary_en: The STAR 50 Index rose over 5% in the morning session, with semiconductor chip stocks surging. US media reported that a temporary deal to open the Strait of Hormuz is 'close.' Trump said talks with Iran are progressing well, with more news in the next 48 hours. Kansas City Fed President Schmid said policy needs to be tightened to lower inflation. A-share 'Yi-Zhong-Tian' companies collectively responded to the US optical module ban. Reports said DeepSeek has restarted financing at a pre-investment valuation of RMB 500 billion. Foreign-owned mutual fund firms moving into investment advisory? headlines.title: A股“易中天”集体回应美国光模块禁令
headlines.summary: A股通信设备板块今日开盘下跌，随后跌幅集体收窄。有市场消息称，美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）正在起草一项禁令，旨在禁止美国进口中国数据中心组件新机型，包括光模块。当日，记者以投资者身份分别致电中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信董秘办。中际旭创董秘办工作人员称，公司已注意到相关市场信息，经核实，美国联邦通信委员会尚未出台相关领域限制性文件。该负责人称，“因为美国联邦通信委员会并未出台相关领域限制性文件，公司对相关传闻不予评述。”

headlines.title_en: A-share 'Yizhongtian' collectively responds to US optical module ban
headlines.summary_en: A-share communications equipment stocks opened lower today but narrowed losses collectively. Market chatter said the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) is drafting a ban aimed at prohibiting US imports of new models of Chinese data center components, including optical modules. On the day, reporters contacted the board secretary offices of Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink, and Tianfu Communication as investors. Zhongji Innolight's board secretary staff said the company had noted the market information and, after verification, the FCC had not yet issued restrictive documents in the relevant field. The official said, 'Because the FCC has not issued restrictive documents in the relevant field, the company will not comment on the rumors.'
